canonical_redirect_match.provider_record_id: The final canonical OpenAlex Work identifier, not the superseded requested Work identifier.
requirements: The first archived request URL represents the exact requested OpenAlex Work ID.
One or more archived redirect hops form a contiguous chain generated by the frozen transport.
Every redirect remains HTTPS and within the OpenAlex provider/endpoint policy already enforced by the frozen transport.
The final archived request URL Work token equals the canonical Work token in the successful response top-level id.
If ids.openalex is present, its canonical Work token equals the same final Work token.
The terminal record retains the original exact requested identifier.

direct_match.rule: If no Work-ID-changing redirect occurred, the canonical top-level OpenAlex Work token must equal the exact requested Work token.

rejected_cases: Different returned Work ID without an archived Work-ID-changing redirect.
Redirect target Work ID differs from successful payload top-level Work ID.
ids.openalex conflicts with the final canonical Work ID.

raw_archive_integrity_extension.bundle_digest: SHA256 of canonical JSON array containing each relative path and member SHA256.
raw_archive_integrity_extension.bundle_members: Every regular file beneath the exact logical lookup raw archive root, sorted by relative POSIX path.
raw_archive_integrity_extension.purpose: Bind redirect provenance and all raw request/response evidence used by the adapter, rather than protecting only terminal.json and the final body.
raw_archive_integrity_extension.recovery_rule: Durable adapter evidence may advance a later guard checkpoint only if the complete raw archive bundle reproduces the stored bundle SHA.

reason: The frozen transport explicitly permits and tests same-provider OpenAlex redirects whose final canonical Work identifier differs from the originally requested Work identifier. Adapter v1 direct-equality semantics would incorrectly reject that legitimate redirect case. A separate pacing correction is also required because ProviderPacer state is process-local.

request_pacing_revision.cold_start_scope: first underlying request per provider per runner process
request_pacing_revision.reason: ProviderPacer retains last-request timestamps only in memory. A new process must not assume that the previous process has already been idle for the provider interval.
request_pacing_revision.rule: Before the first underlying executor invocation for a provider in a runner process, wait at least 0.5 s. Then use ProviderPacer immediately before every underlying executor invocation, including redirects and retries.

required_new_hostile_tests: OpenAlex Work-ID direct match remains accepted.
OpenAlex Work-ID W1 -> W2 same-provider redirect with final W2 payload is accepted and identified as matched_via_verified_openalex_redirect.
W1 request returning W2 without redirect is rejected.
W1 redirecting to W2 but returning W3 is rejected.
Tampering with archived redirect metadata after durable adapter evidence causes recovery failure.
Raw archive bundle digest covers request metadata, response metadata, bodies and terminal record.
A fresh runner process waits 0.5 s before its first underlying provider request.
Redirect and retry requests continue to be paced.
No real network request is possible in the mocked implementation test suite.
